name: Ha Long cu ky noodles
summary: Bún cù kỳ is white noodles with claw meat seared in onion and garlic, the cracked claws in the bowl, and a broth from the body. The meat is sweet, and it does not taste like crab.
origin: Hạ Long and Quảng Ninh. Bún cù kỳ Hạ Long sits beside chả mực. The bowl is also described as existing only in Quảng Ninh.
howToEat: The claw is the meat. It is seared with onion and garlic, then set on white noodles with the claws already cracked. The broth is cooked from the body after the meat is picked out.
Sold in the morning with bún bề bề, and still at lunch in the eating areas and local markets at Bãi Cháy and Giếng Đồn.
where: Bãi Cháy and Giếng Đồn, on the 13 Mar 2019 account. People catch cù kỳ from holes in the rock.
priceBand: 35,000–50,000 đồng a bowl (13 Mar 2019). Current price: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Bun cu ky Ha Long — claw meat on white noodles
seoDescription: Bún cù kỳ is sweet claw meat, seared with onion and garlic, on white noodles in a broth from the body.
taste: The meat is sweet and does not taste like crab.
